annotation.evidence_span: When an endpoint issues a connection ID, it MUST accept packets that carry this connection ID for the duration of the connection or until its peer invalidates the connection ID via a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame ([frame-retire-connection-id]).
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint must continue to accept packets with the connection ID until the connection ends or the peer retires it, even if the endpoint itself retires the ID.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint must stop accepting packets with the connection ID as soon as it retires it, regardless of whether the peer has retired it.
annotation.justification: The clause does not explicitly state what happens when the endpoint retires the connection ID, creating an under‑specification that allows two reasonable interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: Whether the endpoint must cease accepting packets after it retires a connection ID, or whether it must continue to accept until the peer retires it, is not specified in the clause itself. This missing constraint leads to two materially different implementation behaviours.
